summary: Legacy DAG view removed from public/graph.html. 11 surgical edits: dropped the DAG toggle button (Flow now first + default-on, Cloud second), #dag element, #dag/#edges/.level/.node* CSS, #dag.hide rule, and the renderDag/levelize/drawEdges functions; tick() and setView() reduced to two views (Cloud|Flow); resize handler no longer calls drawEdges; currentView default migrated stale localStorage 'dag'->'flow'. KEPT: shared status styles (.s-*, .badge, chips), add-edge UI (selects + populateEdgeSelects + addEdge), detail panel, routes/agents feeds. Verified: node --check SYNTAX OK; 0 dangling refs to renderDag/levelize/drawEdges/getElementById('dag')/data-view=dag; served /graph has no DAG button, Flow button present, default-flow migration line present. KNOWN GAP: cross-workspace 'ghost' stub nodes were only rendered by the old DAG view — Flow/Cloud currently skip ghost: deps, so ghost nodes no longer appear (no ghosts in current workspace; can be added to Flow later if needed). User: hard-reload; dashboard now opens straight into Flow.
